title: No confidence in Valorum
description: To protect her planet from Trade Federation aggression, Queen Amidala of Naboo allies herself with sympathetic ally Palpatine in a political move that ultimately unseats well-intended Chancellor Valorum. Although now this devastating attack will be addressed and hopefully reversed, the rising power of seemingly benign Chancellor Palpatine will prove troubling with the passage of time. Returning to Naboo with her Jedi allies, the courageous Amidala takes on Gunray's invading forces first-hand, receiving some unexpected aid by eager-for-action stowaway Anakin Skywalker. Even at this young age, the boy's command of the Force is considerable...
